auth.subtitle: School Management System
auth.chooseSchoolHint: Your account exists in more than one school.

fees.title: Fees & payments
fees.description: Issue student bills and record collections in NPR. Totals cover all billing periods. Summary totals cover the whole school before filters.
fees.disabled: Fees are disabled in school settings
fees.startHint: Create a fee structure, then issue a bill for a student.
fees.name: Fee name
fees.searchHint: First 50 matches; search by name or admission number.
fees.periodHint: Use a consistent period, e.g. 2083-07. A fee can only be billed once per student and period.
fees.bulkSkipHint: Existing bills are skipped. Only active students in the current academic year are included. Review selections and discounts before issuing.
fees.bulkNoStudents: No active students in this class or section.
fees.bulkDiscountError: Discounts must be valid, cannot exceed the fee, and must leave a positive bill total.
fees.bulkNoYear: Set a current academic year before bulk billing.
fees.remindHint: In-app reminders only. Parents receive at most one reminder per bill per Nepal calendar day. Paid bills, changed balances, inactive/unlinked parents and reminders already sent today are skipped.
fees.remindSettled: Paid — no reminder will be sent.
fees.remindNoParents: No active linked parents — contact the school office to update guardian details.
fees.remindResult: Created {{sent}} in-app reminders for {{remindedBills}} bills. Skipped {{skippedRecipients}} recipients (already reminded, paid/changed bill or no longer linked).
fees.remindSelectPage: Select outstanding bills on this page
fees.smsHint: Up to 50 SMS per batch. Messages may use multiple credits. Each bill/parent has one attempt per Nepal day, separate from in-app reminders. Failed, pending or uncertain attempts are not retried automatically; check history/provider before another attempt. Balances and phones are rechecked before submission.
fees.smsSimulation: Console provider: simulation only; no text messages will be delivered.
fees.smsNotConfigured: SMS credentials are missing. Configure the Sparrow token and sender in the backend environment.
fees.smsResult: Provider accepted: {{accepted}}. Simulated: {{simulated}}. Rejected: {{failed}}. Uncertain: {{unknown}}. Skipped: {{skippedRecipients}}. Acceptance does not confirm handset delivery.
fees.delivery_SENDING: Submission in progress or interrupted - verify before resending
fees.smsAttemptToday: SMS attempt already recorded today - skipped
fees.reportsHint: Class and section use current active enrollments. Totals include every matching row, not just the visible page.
fees.reportPaymentDates: Date range includes payments recorded in Nepal time. Maximum 366 days. Net totals exclude payments reversed as of now, using their original payment dates.
fees.reportUnpaidDates: Date range selects bill due dates (AD). Balances are current, not historical. Payment-method and collector filters do not apply.
fees.reportApplyFirst: Apply your filter changes before exporting.
fees.reverseHint: Correct an incorrectly recorded payment. The full amount will be removed from the paid balance and restored as outstanding. The original payment and reversal reason stay in the audit history. Handle any cash or bank refund separately.
fees.recurringHint: Save monthly plans, discounts and schedules for one academic year. Reviewed billing is the default; automatic billing requires explicit approval per plan.
fees.recurringDayHint: Due day must be on or after the billing day in the same month.
fees.recurringDates: Academic year {{year}} - Bill date {{billing}} AD - Due {{due}} AD
fees.recurringDiscountHint: Saved discounts apply to future bills in this plan. Existing bills are skipped and remain unchanged. Save discounts to refresh planned totals before issuing.
fees.recurringSaveFirst: Save your discount changes and review the refreshed totals before issuing.
fees.autoWorkerOff: The automatic billing worker is disabled in the backend configuration. Reviewed monthly billing is still available.
fees.autoResult_SKIPPED: No new run started: the month is complete, not due, paused, disabled, outside its year, or another worker is running.
fees.autoResult_FAILED: Billing failed. Review the latest failure log, correct the cause, and retry.
fees.autoApprovalHint: Approve this fee amount for automatic monthly bills for active students, using saved discounts. New opt-ins start on the next billing date. After downtime, only the current month can catch up; earlier months need reviewed billing. The plan stops outside its academic year. Fee changes or loss of the authorizing user's access require review.
fees.autoReapprovalHint: Reauthorizing an already automatic plan preserves its start date and allows retrying a due current month with the newly approved amount and user.
fees.autoConfirmLabel: I authorize this plan to issue monthly bills automatically.
